newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SLALOM WINNER CLAUDIA RIEGLER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SLALOM WINNER CLAUDIA RIEGLER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Claudia Riegler, winner of the World Cup women's slalom at Park City, Utah, on Saturday:
Nationality: Carries both Austrian and New Zealand passports, skis for New Zealand
Prior World Cup victories: One slalom, 1996 at Serre Chevalier, France

Other: Got caught in the Austrian numbers game as a junior skier and made the switch to New Zealand three years ago. After she finished fourth in the world championship slalom last season, Austrian coaches asked her to return to the team. She refused. "It's not just a country beside my name. New Zealand is in my heart."
